payload.posture: Read Romans 10:5–13 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the word is near in heart and mouth. For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.” For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
